caption: A loupe is held over a ring, and the ring's details appear greatly enlarged through it.

sa.check: A loupe is held over a ring.
The ring's details appear greatly enlarged through it.
The rest of the ring and the desk look normal size.

pc.expect: The enlargement applies only to what is seen through the loupe.
pc.fail: The desk is enlarged; or the ring is unchanged through the loupe; or the enlarged view is offset from the loupe.

pc.expect: The ring is unchanged; the enlarged details are its own.
pc.fail: A different ring appears; or the ring changes; or the image is mirrored.

pc.expect: The loupe moves only with the hand and the ring stays put.
pc.fail: The loupe floats; or the ring slides; or the image shifts with both still.
It bends; or ripples; or goes opaque.
The loupe duplicates; or the ring vanishes; or the hand passes through the loupe.

pc.expect: The ring and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: The ring changes colour; or the desk changes; or the loupe changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
